Test Description: PCIe Device Enumeration Test - Performs link training, cache programming, BAR enumeration, and device discovery for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 controllers
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0x0 to address 0xE6004100 to initialize control register
Pass/Fail Criteria: Write completes without error

Test Description: Cache Programming - Configure COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 for PCIE0: Set ARCACHE_MODE (bits 3:6) and AWCACHE_MODE (bits 11:14) to 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF; Step 2: Set bits[11:14]=0xF (AWCACHE_MODE); Step 3: Set bits[3:6]=0xF (ARCACHE_MODE); Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Register fields updated to 0xF successfully

Test Description: Cache Programming - Configure COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 for PCIE0: Set ARCACHE_VALUE (bits 19:22) and AWCACHE_VALUE (bits 27:30) to 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF; Step 2: Set bits[27:30]=0xF (AWCACHE_VALUE); Step 3: Set bits[19:22]=0xF (ARCACHE_VALUE); Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Register fields updated to 0xF successfully

Test Description: Cache Programming - Configure COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 for PCIE1: Set ARCACHE_MODE (bits 3:6) and AWCACHE_MODE (bits 11:14) to 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE1; Step 2: Set bits[11:14]=0xF; Step 3: Set bits[3:6]=0xF; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Register fields updated to 0xF successfully

Test Description: Cache Programming - Configure COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 for PCIE1: Set ARCACHE_VALUE (bits 19:22) and AWCACHE_VALUE (bits 27:30) to 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE1; Step 2: Set bits[27:30]=0xF; Step 3: Set bits[19:22]=0xF; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Register fields updated to 0xF successfully

Test Description: Wait and re-apply cache programming for PCIE0 - All cache mode and value fields set to 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Wait 20 cycles; Step 2: Read register; Step 3: Set all 4 cache fields to 0xF; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: All cache fields set to 0xF after wait

Test Description: SII0 Link Status Polling - Read SII0 register at offset 0xC0 and poll until bits match 0xD1
Test Steps: Step 1: Read SII0 reg at 0xC0; Step 2: Check (data & 0xD1) == 0xD1; Step 3: Loop until condition met
Pass/Fail Criteria: SII0 status register bits[7:0] & 0xD1 == 0xD1 indicating link up

Test Description: SII1 Link Status Polling - Read SII1 register at offset 0xC0 and poll until bits match 0xD1
Test Steps: Step 1: Read SII1 reg at 0xC0; Step 2: Check (data & 0xD1) == 0xD1; Step 3: Loop until condition met
Pass/Fail Criteria: SII1 status register bits[7:0] & 0xD1 == 0xD1 indicating link up

Test Description: Read Vendor ID from PCIe Slave 0 at offset 0x0 (TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG)
Test Steps: Step 1: Read PCIe slave0 register at offset 0x0; Step 2: Extract Vendor ID from bits[15:0]
Pass/Fail Criteria: Vendor ID matches expected value 0x16C3

Test Description: Enable Memory Space and Bus Master - Write 0x7 to PCIe Slave 0 at offset 0x4 (TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG)
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0x7 to command register to enable IO, Memory Space, and Bus Master
Pass/Fail Criteria: Command register accepts write value 0x7

Test Description: Memory Base Programming for DM0 x4 and DM1 x4
Test Steps: Step 1: Call mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); Step 2: Call mem_base_program_dm1_x4(); Step 3: Wait 10 cycles
Pass/Fail Criteria: Memory base programming completes successfully

Test Description: System Control Register Writes - Write 0x1 to multiple control registers
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0x1 to each of 6 system control registers at addresses 0xE690000C through 0xE6900034
Pass/Fail Criteria: All writes complete without error

Test Description: Disable Cache Programming for PCIE0 - Set ARCACHE_VALUE (bits 19:22) to 0x0 while keeping MODE fields at 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read register; Step 2: Keep MODE fields at 0xF; Step 3: Set ARCACHE_VALUE bits[19:22]=0x0; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Cache value field cleared to 0x0 while mode remains 0xF

Test Description: Disable Cache Programming for PCIE1 - Set ARCACHE_VALUE (bits 19:22) to 0x0 while keeping MODE fields at 0xF
Test Steps: Step 1: Read register for PCIE1; Step 2: Keep MODE fields at 0xF; Step 3: Set ARCACHE_VALUE=0x0; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Cache value field cleared to 0x0 for PCIE1

Test Description: Full Cache Disable for PCIE0 - Set both ARCACHE_VALUE and AWCACHE_VALUE to 0x0
Test Steps: Step 1: Wait 10 cycles; Step 2: Read register; Step 3: Set bits[27:30]=0x0 and bits[19:22]=0x0; Step 4: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Both cache value fields cleared to 0x0

Test Description: Full Cache Disable for PCIE1 - Set both ARCACHE_VALUE and AWCACHE_VALUE to 0x0
Test Steps: Step 1: Read register for PCIE1; Step 2: Set bits[27:30]=0x0 and bits[19:22]=0x0; Step 3: Write back
Pass/Fail Criteria: Both cache value fields cleared to 0x0 for PCIE1

Test Description: PCIe Slave 1 BAR Write Test - Write 0xFFFFFFFF to BAR registers at offsets 0x10-0x24
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24 on PCIe Slave 1
Pass/Fail Criteria: All BAR registers accept 0xFFFFFFFF write for BAR sizing

Test Description: PCIe Slave 1 BAR Read-back - Read BAR registers at offsets 0x10-0x24 to determine BAR sizes
Test Steps: Step 1: Read back offsets 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24; Step 2: Determine BAR sizes from read-back values
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values reflect BAR size capabilities (masked bits)

Test Description: PCIe Slave 1 BAR Programming - Write base addresses to BAR registers
Pass/Fail Criteria: BAR registers programmed with correct base addresses

Test Description: PCIe Slave 1 BAR Verify - Read back programmed BAR values
Test Steps: Step 1: Read back all 6 BAR registers; Step 2: Verify values match programmed values
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values match written base addresses

Test Description: PCIe Slave 0 BAR Write Test - Write 0xFFFFFFFF to BAR registers at offsets 0x10-0x24
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24 on PCIe Slave 0
Pass/Fail Criteria: All BAR registers accept 0xFFFFFFFF write for BAR sizing

Test Description: PCIe Slave 0 BAR Read-back - Read BAR registers at offsets 0x10-0x24 to determine BAR sizes
Test Steps: Step 1: Read back offsets 0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1C,0x20,0x24; Step 2: Determine BAR sizes
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values reflect BAR size capabilities

Test Description: PCIe Slave 0 BAR Programming - Write base addresses to BAR registers
Pass/Fail Criteria: BAR registers programmed with correct base addresses

Test Description: PCIe Slave 0 BAR Verify - Read back programmed BAR values
Test Steps: Step 1: Read back all 6 BAR registers; Step 2: Verify values match programmed values
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values match written base addresses

Test Description: Final Synchronization - Poll address 0xE6004100 until value equals 0x12345678
Test Steps: Step 1: Read 0xE6004100; Step 2: Compare with 0x12345678; Step 3: Loop with 5-cycle wait until match; Step 4: Call finish(0)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Register value equals 0x12345678 indicating test completion

Test Description: PCIe Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 5 RC0 DBI controller registers after reset
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each of 5 RC0 registers; Step 2: Compare with expected default 0x0; Step 3: Report mismatch as FAILED
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 5 RC0 registers read 0x0 (default reset value)

Test Description: PCIe Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 5 RC1 DBI controller registers after reset
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each of 5 RC1 registers; Step 2: Compare with expected default 0x0; Step 3: Report mismatch as FAILED
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 5 RC1 registers read 0x0 (default reset value)

Test Description: SII0 Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 3 SII0 registers (TRANSMIT_HEADER2, TRANSMIT_HEADER3, PHY_CONTROL_23)
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each of 3 SII0 registers; Step 2: Compare with expected default 0x0; Step 3: Report mismatch as FAILED
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 3 SII0 registers read 0x0 (default reset value)

Test Description: SII1 Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 3 SII1 registers (TRANSMIT_HEADER2, TRANSMIT_HEADER3, PHY_CONTROL_23)
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each of 3 SII1 registers; Step 2: Compare with expected default 0x0; Step 3: Report mismatch as FAILED
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 3 SII1 registers read 0x0 (default reset value)

Test Description: PHY Reset Control - Write PHY reset control value to enable PHY for PCIE0 and PCIE1
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0x01203000 to PCIE0 SII PHY_RST_CONTROL; Step 2: Write 0x01203000 to PCIE1 SII PHY_RST_CONTROL
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY reset control registers programmed successfully

Test Description: PHY0 Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 3 PHY0 registers at addresses 0xE68860B8, 0xE68862B8, 0xE68864B8
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each PHY0 register; Step 2: Extract 16-bit value based on address alignment (upper/lower half); Step 3: Compare with default 0x0
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 3 PHY0 registers read 0x0 after 16-bit extraction

Test Description: PHY1 Register Reset Value Check - Verify default values of 3 PHY1 registers at addresses 0xE68A60B8, 0xE68A62B8, 0xE68A64B8
Test Steps: Step 1: Read each PHY1 register; Step 2: Extract 16-bit value based on address alignment; Step 3: Compare with default 0x0
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 3 PHY1 registers read 0x0 after 16-bit extraction

Test Description: RC0 DBI Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF to 5 RC0 registers and verify read-back
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to all 5 RC0 registers; Step 2: Read back each register; Step 3: Compare read value with 0xFFFFFFFF
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 5 RC0 registers read back 0xFFFFFFFF

Test Description: RC1 DBI Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF to 5 RC1 registers and verify read-back
Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to all 5 RC1 registers; Step 2: Read back each register; Step 3: Compare read value with 0xFFFFFFFF
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 5 RC1 registers read back 0xFFFFFFFF

Test Description: SII0 Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF (masked) to 3 SII0 registers and verify
Test Steps: Step 1: Write (0xFFFFFFFF & mask) to each SII0 register; Step 2: Read back; Step 3: Compare with (0xFFFFFFFF & mask)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values match (pattern & write_mask) for all 3 SII0 registers

Test Description: SII1 Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF (masked) to 3 SII1 registers and verify
Test Steps: Step 1: Write (0xFFFFFFFF & mask) to each SII1 register; Step 2: Read back; Step 3: Compare with (0xFFFFFFFF & mask)
Pass/Fail Criteria: Read values match (pattern & write_mask) for all 3 SII1 registers

Test Description: PHY0 Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0x7BAF (masked with 0x1FFF) to 3 PHY0 registers
Test Steps: Step 1: Write (0x7BAF & 0x1FFF) to each PHY0 register; Step 2: Read back with 16-bit extraction; Step 3: Compare (read & 0x1FFF) with (0x7BAF & 0x1FFF)
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY0 registers read back 0x1BAF after masking

Test Description: PHY1 Register Read/Write Test - Write pattern 0x7BAF (masked with 0x1FFF) to 3 PHY1 registers

Test Steps: Step 1: Write 0xAAAAAAAA to all 5 RC0 registers; Step 2: Read back; Step 3: Compare
Pass/Fail Criteria: All 5 RC0 registers read back 0xAAAAAAAA

Test Steps: Step 1: Write (0x003B & 0x1FFF) to each PHY0 register; Step 2: Read back; Step 3: Compare (read & 0x1FFF) with 0x003B

Test Description: Test Completion - Report overall pass/fail based on err1 and err2 error counters
Test Steps: Step 1: Evaluate (err2 || err1); Step 2: Call finish() with combined error status; Step 3: finish(0) = PASS, finish(non-zero) = FAIL
Pass/Fail Criteria: err1 == 0 AND err2 == 0 for overall PASS
